title: An animated picture exports as a GIF
goal: Someone who asks for 'a gif of a bouncing ball' now gets a moving icon, but Export only offers an animated SVG or a still picture, so there is no way to save the .gif they asked for. Export on a picture that moves should offer GIF, playing the same loop the timeline plays.
notes: Found by asking-the-new-window-for-an-animated-icon-makes (2026-11-07): 'a gif' now routes to Ask's moving icon (AskMotion.gifWords). ExportDialog.swift ExportChoice is picture(ImageCodec.Format) or svg; the moving route is animatedSVG only. Recordings already write GIF (Recording.swift case gif, RecordingExport.swift), which may help render a timed picture's frames.
acceptance: Export on a picture with keys offers GIF beside SVG; the file plays the same loop as the timeline in Safari, Preview and Chrome.
A still picture does not offer GIF.
A GIF of a 512 icon is a reasonable size (the measured bytes are in the audit).
